claim: Across three independently captured physical disks, the LBA7-pointed Region A extent is a 3072-byte high-entropy nonzero object while the separately sampled CHS-0x40000 2048-byte IIR candidate window is all zero on all three disks.
proves: The physical Region A object is not the separately sampled CHS-0x40000 IIR candidate window on these three disks.
Treating Region A bytes as IIR bytes solely because both are tail metadata candidates is contradicted by the physical captures.
limitations: This does not by itself prove what Region A plaintext means or identify its producer/consumer.
The label iir.bin is a capture-script address hypothesis at CHS-0x40000, not a runtime PartInfo-derived ReadIIR address observation.
